scope: Reference workflow evidence for the recorded builds. Acceptance IDs retain their architecture-pack meaning; these profiles can exercise subsets.

status_meanings.executed_pass: The named bounded differential ran and passed. Evidence contains the decision and setup.
status_meanings.not_executed: No paired ExaCopy/reference run. Version and platform can describe a planned profile or an identity-only probe.

profiles.configuration_and_invocation: cmp -s LEFT RIGHT; exacopy diff LEFT RIGHT --compare bytes --workers N --format json --managed-macos (N=1,4,16)
profiles.fixtures: Seven generated regular-file pairs: empty, equal binary, first/middle/last changed bytes, unequal length, sparse mismatch; final symlink control.
profiles.expected_behavior: Exact relation agrees with the generated witness; input bytes, identity, mode, mtime and namespace are preserved.
profiles.actual_exacopy_behavior: All 21 regular-file results matched cmp and the expected witness; the final symlink returned E_OPEN_INPUT, complete=false.
profiles.known_deviation: cmp followed the final symlink and returned equality.
profiles.deviation_rationale: Capability-scoped admission refuses redirection through the final path component.

profiles.configuration_and_invocation: cmp -s LEFT RIGHT; exacopy diff LEFT RIGHT --compare bytes --workers N --format json (N=1,4,16)
profiles.fixtures: Seven generated regular-file pairs: empty, equal binary, first/middle/last changed bytes, unequal length, sparse mismatch; final symlink control.
profiles.expected_behavior: Exact relation agrees with cmp and the generated witness. Input bytes, identity, mode, link count, mtime and namespace are preserved.
profiles.actual_exacopy_behavior: All 21 regular-file results matched cmp and the generated witness. The final symlink returned exit 2/E_OPEN_INPUT with complete=false.
profiles.known_deviation: cmp followed the final symlink and returned equality.
profiles.deviation_rationale: Capability-scoped admission refuses redirection through the final path component.

profiles.configuration_and_invocation: rsync --dry-run --checksum --itemize-changes --out-format=%i -- LEFT RIGHT; ExaCopy exact diff with 1/4/16 workers.
profiles.fixtures: The same seven generated pairs as cmp, with equal mtimes and modes for equal-sized pairs.
profiles.expected_behavior: Rsync gives a content transfer item only for different pairs. Exact equality is independently established with cmp.
profiles.actual_exacopy_behavior: Every ExaCopy comparison agreed with cmp and the itemized rsync dry-run result; inputs were preserved.
profiles.known_deviation: Rsync plans updates using a checksum and prints an itemization; ExaCopy reports exact byte relation and a difference witness.
profiles.deviation_rationale: A checksum match is advisory and does not establish byte-exact equality.

profiles.configuration_and_invocation: rsync --dry-run --checksum --itemize-changes --out-format=%i -- LEFT RIGHT; ExaCopy exact diff with 1/4/16 workers.
profiles.fixtures: The same seven generated pairs as the Linux cmp profile, with equal mtimes and modes for equal-sized pairs.
profiles.expected_behavior: Rsync gives a content transfer item only for different pairs. GNU cmp independently establishes the exact relation.
profiles.actual_exacopy_behavior: All 21 ExaCopy comparisons agreed with cmp and the rsync dry-run itemization. All seven regular-file pairs retained their inputs.
profiles.known_deviation: Rsync plans updates using a checksum and prints an itemization. ExaCopy reports the exact relation and a difference witness.
profiles.deviation_rationale: A checksum match is advisory and does not establish byte-exact equality.

profiles.configuration_and_invocation: rsync --ignore-existing --itemize-changes --out-format=%i -- SOURCE TARGET; exacopy copy SOURCE TARGET --profile PROFILE --format json.
profiles.fixtures: Generated 4096-byte source, absent target and different 4096-byte incumbent. ExaCopy also publishes fresh 4 KiB and 64 MiB targets in one warm-up and five measured trials per size.
profiles.expected_behavior: The new target compares equal by cmp; the existing target and source stay byte- and identity-stable.
profiles.actual_exacopy_behavior: All twelve new targets passed independent cmp, mode and mtime checks, distinct identity checks and committed-state inspection. The existing target caused exit 3/E_CONFLICT with no publication.
profiles.known_deviation: Rsync exited 0 with an empty itemization for the incumbent. ExaCopy exits 3 and reports an explicit conflict.
profiles.deviation_rationale: A skipped incumbent cannot satisfy a preserved copy request. Rsync skip is only tested without an incumbent-creation race.

profiles.reference_version: 3.5.2 (planned local peer pin; capture negotiated protocol in each run)
profiles.configuration_and_invocation: Pin both peers; record options and interrupted transfer stage, compare --partial or --partial-dir with safe verified range adoption.
profiles.fixtures: Deterministic 64 MiB same-length and inserted-block variants, wrong retained ranges and late incumbent.
profiles.expected_behavior: Restore exact final bytes with verified reuse; report payload, retransmission and refused ranges.
profiles.actual_exacopy_behavior: Local single-file staging exists. Remote delta and rsync wire interoperability are outside the current implementation.
profiles.reproduction: Use a disposable local two-peer lab once the ExaCopy endpoint exists; capture transport counts and independently compare all final files.

profiles.configuration_and_invocation: Enable verify after copy; choose Skip for incumbent handling; save verification log and option export.
profiles.fixtures: One 4 KiB and one 64 MiB generated file; different incumbent; failure point before verification.
profiles.expected_behavior: Preserve incumbent/source and verify a new target; skipped entries and interrupted stages remain explicit.
profiles.actual_exacopy_behavior: Local Linux copy exposes staged hash readback and refuses incumbents. Windows and TeraCopy differential unexecuted.
profiles.reproduction: In a disposable VM, execute the reference settings and the qualified Windows ExaCopy counterpart; compare target bytes and preserve logs before and after interruption.

profiles.configuration_and_invocation: Use Diff (No overwrite) with conventional destination reread verification and SHA-256; capture the log and exported settings.
profiles.fixtures: Flat tiny-file corpus, deterministic 64 MiB binary, and different same-name incumbent.
profiles.expected_behavior: Independently verify every materialized file; report incumbent and incomplete transfer distinctly.
profiles.actual_exacopy_behavior: Local Linux copy exposes staged hash readback and refuses incumbents. Windows and FastCopy differential unexecuted.
profiles.reproduction: Provision a disposable NTFS fixture and capture the reference settings, reports, cmp results, and the matching ExaCopy run after Windows qualification.

profiles.configuration_and_invocation: Use Hex Compare, then Folder Compare in binary mode; use Text Compare with normalization selected and record settings.
profiles.fixtures: Local exact-byte fixture corpus, renamed tree, LF/CRLF variants and three-way overlapping edits.
profiles.expected_behavior: Exact equality agrees with cmp; normalized similarity is labeled; independent trees and conflicts stay intact.
profiles.actual_exacopy_behavior: CLI exact regular-file comparison is implemented. No Beyond Compare application, tree diff, specialized view or merge was exercised.
profiles.reproduction: Use fresh synthetic pairs and save native reports, then diff corresponding decisions against the exact and normalized oracles once implemented.

profiles.configuration_and_invocation: SFTP binary transfer with explicit pinned host key and disposable credentials. Record reconnect and temp-file settings.
profiles.fixtures: A 64 MiB binary, a partial target, and a same-name incumbent; restart the test connection.
profiles.expected_behavior: Validate identity on reconnect; independently verify completed bytes and preserve any incumbent.
profiles.actual_exacopy_behavior: ExaCopy has no SFTP endpoint or equivalent GUI queue in this slice.
profiles.reproduction: Use an isolated key-authenticated test server, save redacted transfer logs, and compare reports plus server-side bytes when the endpoint exists.

profiles.configuration_and_invocation: Pass a private scratch .ffs_batch and alternate scratch GlobalSettings.xml to the bundle executable. Select File Content comparison, exclude symlinks, assign no synchronization action in all four categories, cancel on error and close automatically.
profiles.fixtures: Two scratch directories each contain sample.bin with hex bytes 007fff414243 and mtime 1700000000. A paired case should also flip a byte on one side while retaining the size and mtime.
profiles.expected_behavior: Identify the equal pair and the same-size mismatch by content. Compare pair decisions against ExaCopy and the generated bytes.
profiles.actual_exacopy_behavior: ExaCopy supports exact comparison of regular files on managed APFS. The reference startup probe aborted and no paired comparison ran.

profiles.configuration_and_invocation: Use Compare by file content and Two way sync; capture preview; run mutations only on disposable trees with Versioning.
profiles.fixtures: Common baseline, changed/renamed/target-only paths, divergent edits and inaccessible former subtree.
profiles.expected_behavior: Conflicts and incomplete observations remain explicit; baseline advances only on complete verified outcomes.
profiles.actual_exacopy_behavior: ExaCopy has no tree synchronization workflow in this slice.
profiles.reproduction: Generate baseline and two follow-up trees, save preview and log, and independently inventory bytes/version history after the qualified ExaCopy run.

profiles.reference_version: OpenSSH 9.7p1 client identified; peer build and negotiated SFTP versions must be pinned
profiles.platform: Linux client and OpenSSH Linux peer planned
profiles.configuration_and_invocation: Use sftp -F test_config -b commands with binary put/get, an explicit known_hosts file and disposable keys.
profiles.fixtures: Generated binary and interrupted transfer, same-length incorrect retained range, and changed host key.
profiles.expected_behavior: Read back real bytes, validate host key and retained ranges, and keep namespace durability evidence separate.
profiles.actual_exacopy_behavior: No ExaCopy SSH or SFTP workload was run. The host ssh -V inventory alone is informational.
profiles.reproduction: Use an isolated SSH lab and capture peer version, negotiated SFTP protocol/extensions, exact final bytes and refusal reports.

profiles.configuration_and_invocation: Create a scratch local repository; take first and changed snapshots, run check --read-data and restore both into separate new subtrees.
